candidate_binding_notes: The v0.15 runtime candidate at 8e67e5d237d432cb8089c35ad5c040632d1b37ff was installed from v0.14, booted healthy, and received the display, touch, button, browser, filename, APP, fault-containment, power-interruption, offline-resume, and future-update checks recorded here.

Promotion exposed a build-identity ordering defect after UTC midnight. Commit f7f3223c0de9c32aad3d546efd68c09f73eedbf7 fixes only the promotion workflow, its authenticity checker and test, and the qualification-only recovery signal helper; the unpublished v0.15 tag was moved to that commit.

The final tag artifact was candidate-bound by CI, internal checksums, semantic comparison of every installed file, on-device preflight, and a complete physical same-version installation followed by healthy boot and protected-state verification.

The recovery signal callback issue was confined to qualification display setup after package replacement; package state was inspected before the physical cut, and the offline recovery path resumed the fully staged runtime candidate without network access.
No promotion or GitHub release was performed during qualification.
